candidates.name: PrivilegeCheck
verified_facts: Tests whether a token contains the requested enabled privilege set
The privilege set records which privileges were used
semantic_limits: Privilege success does not prove DACL access, process ownership, or receipt authenticity.

candidates.name: AccessCheck
verified_facts: Evaluates requested access against a security descriptor and impersonation token
Returns granted access and access status
semantic_limits: The exact generic mapping, desired rights, token, and descriptor must be preserved for a meaningful result.

candidates.name: AccessCheckByType
verified_facts: Performs access checking with an object-type hierarchy
Object-type ordering is validated
semantic_limits: An incorrect object-type list or generic mapping can invalidate conclusions.

candidates.name: AccessCheckByTypeResultList
verified_facts: Returns access results for each object type in a hierarchy
Result-list ordering follows the supplied object-type list
semantic_limits: Per-type results do not prove the descriptor, token, or object was the canonical target.

candidates.name: AreAllAccessesGranted
verified_facts: Tests whether all requested bits are present in a granted-access mask
It is a mask comparison helper
semantic_limits: A positive mask comparison is meaningful only if the granted mask came from a valid access check.

candidates.name: GetSecurityInfo
verified_facts: Retrieves owner, group, DACL, SACL, and descriptor data for a handled object
Requested security-information flags are explicit
semantic_limits: Readback may require privileges and does not by itself prove effective rights or ownership.

candidates.name: GetNamedSecurityInfoW
verified_facts: Retrieves security information for a named object
Supports files, services, registry keys, and other securable object types
semantic_limits: Name resolution and object type must be exact; a similar path or service name is not sufficient.

candidates.name: GetFileSecurityW
verified_facts: Retrieves requested security information for a file or directory
Owner, group, and DACL readback requires appropriate access or ownership
semantic_limits: Successful metadata readback does not prove content integrity, freshness, or safe write access.

candidates.name: GetKernelObjectSecurity
verified_facts: Retrieves security information for a kernel object handle
SACL readback can require ACCESS_SYSTEM_SECURITY and privilege enablement
semantic_limits: A kernel-object descriptor does not prove that the handle belongs to the canonical runner instance.

candidates.name: GetSecurityDescriptorOwner
verified_facts: Extracts the owner SID from a security descriptor
Reports whether the owner was defaulted
semantic_limits: Parsed ownership does not establish effective write permission or task identity.

candidates.name: GetSecurityDescriptorDacl
verified_facts: Extracts the DACL pointer and presence state from a security descriptor
Distinguishes absent, null, and populated DACL conditions
semantic_limits: Treating absent and null DACLs as equivalent can create unsafe authorization conclusions.

candidates.name: GetSecurityDescriptorSacl
verified_facts: Extracts the SACL pointer and presence state from a security descriptor
Reports whether the SACL was defaulted
semantic_limits: SACL access may be incomplete without the required privilege and is not a grant-rights calculation.

candidates.name: GetAclInformation
verified_facts: Retrieves ACL revision, ACE count, and size information
Supports bounded parsing of ACL contents
semantic_limits: ACL header information does not identify trustees or effective permissions.

candidates.name: GetAce
verified_facts: Returns a pointer to an indexed ACE in an ACL
ACE count bounds must be respected
semantic_limits: Individual ACE inspection without canonical ordering and inheritance context can be misleading.

candidates.name: GetExplicitEntriesFromAclA
verified_facts: Returns explicit access entries describing ACL ACEs
Entries include trustee, rights, access mode, and inheritance data
semantic_limits: Explicit entries do not directly compute effective rights across group membership and deny ordering.
